title: THE OVERSEER IGNORES DECOYS
why: His answer g-13 (10-25): No, the Overseer ignores decoys. A decoy pinged 420 every 0.8 s for 6 s and woke every body in reach, the Overseer too, which then walked off its lair toward it. The decoy ping now carries a flag and the Overseer skips it. Every other machine still hears decoys, and the Overseer still hears shots, steps and blasts.
now: The Overseer no longer follows a decoy.

edits.anchor: if(e.kind==='listener') continue;             // it does not take orders from noise twice
